label: Late original / <DEL> step in sequences starting with f
explanation: Fires near the end of the original phase and at the <DEL> step (never during copy, never before t=5) when the first original token is f (first_tok=f carries 84% of activation mass, 19.5x lift). Activation ramps up with absolute step t: weak at t=5-6, strongest at t=7-9, peaking at <DEL> (72% of mass); longer sequences (L=8,9) dominate. Top activations are sequences beginning with f f. Weak, low-quartile activations also occur at <DEL> in long sequences without a leading f (often with f at position 1). Does not depend on the current input token identity.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: f, d, x, 0, n, c; least: y, t, g, 2) and the second original token (most: f, z, j, o, n, 1; least: k, t, 2, y); timing cues that raise it most: t=7, t=8, L=9 & t=8.
